status: descriptive mapped-hazard context; not observed flooding or insurance loss

geographic_method.claims_geography: reported postal ZIP in FEMA claims records
geographic_method.hazard_geography: 2020 Census ZCTAs from the 2025 TIGER/Line ZCTA archive; not USPS ZIP boundaries
geographic_method.aggregation: intersect NFHL zone polygons with each complete target ZCTA in EPSG:4269, then union areas by SFHA_TF class
geographic_method.area_measurement: GRS80 ellipsoidal geodesic area from EPSG:4269 coordinates
geographic_method.coordinate_transform_check: ZCTA representative points round-trip through EPSG:4269 to EPSG:26917 and back
geographic_method.geodesic_area_tolerance: 1e-7 of the full ZCTA area; mapped/SFHA values are capped at the ZCTA/mapped union only within this tolerance and adjustments are reported
geographic_method.sfha_definition: NFHL SFHA_TF = T polygon area; denominator is the full Census ZCTA polygon area
geographic_method.overlap_handling: overlap between SFHA_TF T and F is reported and assigned to SFHA in the exclusive area partition
geographic_method.unrepresented_area: ZCTA area not covered by a returned Flood Hazard Zones polygon; may include water or data gaps and is not labeled flood-free

field_definitions.zcta_area_km2: full selected Census ZCTA polygon geodesic area on the GRS80 ellipsoid
field_definitions.nfhl_mapped_area_km2: union area of all intersecting NFHL zone polygons clipped to the ZCTA
field_definitions.nfhl_mapped_area_adjustment_m2: geodesic edge-segmentation excess capped from mapped area when within the stated tolerance
field_definitions.nfhl_mapped_pct_zcta: NFHL mapped area divided by full ZCTA area, percent
field_definitions.sfha_area_km2: union area with SFHA_TF = T, clipped to ZCTA
field_definitions.sfha_area_adjustment_m2: geodesic edge-segmentation excess capped from SFHA area when within the stated tolerance
field_definitions.sfha_pct_zcta: SFHA area divided by full ZCTA area, percent
field_definitions.sfha_pct_nfhl_mapped: SFHA area divided by NFHL mapped area, percent
field_definitions.non_sfha_area_km2: SFHA_TF = F area after subtracting any overlap with SFHA polygons
field_definitions.unclassified_nfhl_area_km2: mapped area without SFHA_TF equal to T or F
field_definitions.not_represented_by_nfhl_zones_km2: full ZCTA area less mapped zone union; not proof of no flood hazard
field_definitions.sfha_non_sfha_overlap_km2: area of overlap between unions of SFHA_TF T and F polygons
field_definitions.nfhl_polygon_count: number of returned NFHL features with positive-area intersection with the ZCTA
field_definitions.nfhl_study_effective_dates: semicolon-separated effective dates from linked Study_Info map versions
field_definitions.nfhl_dfirm_versions: semicolon-separated DFIRM_ID:VERSION_ID values intersecting the ZCTA
